{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_count_clean = (df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99).sum()
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99) after cleaning: {qa_count_clean}")

# Verify premises
new_count = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'new'].shape[0]
paid_search_count = df[df['channel'] == 'paid_search'].shape[0]
new_paid_search_count = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (df['channel'] == 'paid_search')].shape[0]

print(f"Number of 'new' customers: {new_count}")
print(f"Number of 'paid_search' customers: {paid_search_count}")
print(f"Number of 'new' customers in 'paid_search': {new_paid_search_count}")"}
